title: Review Assistant
summary: A bounded assistant that helps benefits caseworkers locate supporting policy passages while preserving human decisions and uncertainty.
intended_users: Public-benefit caseworkers reviewing complex eligibility documents with accountable human sign-off.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: The project compares automated decisions with bounded suggestions and traces human authority through every state transition.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: The committed alternatives table compares benefits, rejected costs, and the condition that triggers reconsideration.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Model adapters, evidence normalization, policy, review state, and audit records have explicit boundaries.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The project cannot guarantee the factual quality or fairness of an externally configured model.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Reject acceptance attempts that lack an authorized human reviewer. Escalate a suggestion that lacks source provenance or bounded evidence. Remove identifying values nested inside otherwise allowed input structures.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: The project cannot guarantee the factual quality or fairness of an externally configured model. Domain-specific outcome evaluation remains the responsibility of each deploying organization.

testing_strategy: Committed cross-boundary, negative, and boundary tests: test/review-state.test.js, test/review-policy.test.js, test/minimization.test.js. Their presence does not establish that they pass in Finch static review.
security_threat: A model suggestion directly mutates a consequential review decision without human approval. Control: The model adapter can only create a proposal; a separate state machine requires an authorized human transition. Unnecessary identifying information is sent to the configured model adapter. Control: An allowlist-based minimizer removes direct and nested identity fields before adapter invocation.
production_limitation: The project cannot guarantee the factual quality or fairness of an externally configured model. Domain-specific outcome evaluation remains the responsibility of each deploying organization.
technical_debt: Complete deployment-specific runtime, performance, accessibility, and security evaluation before production use.
track_alignment_explanation: AI is essential to producing bounded review suggestions while human authority, provenance, minimization, and escalation remain explicit.

ai_disclosure.purposes: Codex was used to author this deliberately synthetic calibration fixture and its structured submission answers.
ai_disclosure.substantially_generated_areas: All fixture source, documentation, tests, and submission narratives are synthetic and AI-assisted.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: The calibration operator reviews files for intended evidence strength, consistency, and absence of real secrets before pinning the commit.
ai_disclosure.rejected_or_changed_suggestion: Generic claims of runtime correctness were rejected because Finch performs static evidence review only.

ai_disclosure_narrative: This entire project is synthetic AI-assisted test data. It represents no participant, deployed product, or real credential.
